ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*value.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*invoke.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*comspec.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*iex.*")))
